headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning 17-1 behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' charge at the plate, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Colorado Rockies placing Tomoyuki Sugano and Seth Halvorsen on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms and right shoulder inflammation, respectively. The San Francisco Giants have also placed Matt Gage on the 15-day injured list with a left embow strain. Other teams have suffered similar losses, including the Atlanta Braves (Ha-Seong Kim), Texas Rangers (Jakob Junis), Pittsburgh Pirates (Evan Sisk), San Diego Padres (Freddy Fermin and Randy Vásquez).

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Cleveland Guardians acquiring Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. The Washington Nationals have traded for Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros and Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles, while the Athletics traded Ben Hansen to the Boston Red Sox for Brett Harris.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Cubs 17-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning the game 17-1 behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' charge at the plate, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Pirates 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 2 ER, 0 BB, 5 H. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, and 3 AB.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Bryan Reynolds and Ryan O'Hearn leading the charge offensively. Braxton Ashcraft was instrumental in the win, pitching effectively for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 11-4**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a convincing 11-4 victory over the New York Yankees, with multiple players contributing to the team's success. Trevor Larnach, Kody Clemens, Josh Bell, Luke Keaschall, Alex Jackson, Jasson Domínguez, and Max Schuemann were among the impact hitters for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Sugano Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms, effective retroactive to July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians in Trade**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move marks a change in the 2026 MLB roster for Degges.
